name: Alina's Patisserie
notes: From the bakery's own website menu (last updated May 2024). The website lists no prices; call for pricing and custom orders. Cake flavors, fillings and frostings are option lists for custom cakes and are kept as one entry each. Address, phone and hours are for the Fairfield shop (the old page had a wrong Black Rock Tpke number); the site also lists a Westport shop at 1252 Post Rd E.
